title: Wiemer intro (v2)
description: A spacious product introduction: a small accent tag and a very large two-line display heading on the left, then, set lower in the right third, a subheading, a few paragraphs and an arrow link. Heading letters rise into place one by one; paragraphs lift in as they arrive.
notes: text stacks under the heading on phones
reveals are CSS scroll-driven; static HTML shows everything
